rule.assert: SIP3;INFO;A way of indicating the status of the package and to instruct the OAIS on how to properly handle the package. If not set, the expected behaviour is equal to NEW.
SIP3;ERROR;The RECORDSTATUS must have value from vocabulary.
SIP4;ERROR;The metsHdr element MUST have a csip:OAISPACKAGETYPE attribute.
SIP5;INFO;A reference to the Submission Agreement associated with the package.
SIP5;ERROR;The altRecordID with TYPE='SUBMISSIONAGREEMENT' may exist only once.
SIP6;INFO;An optional reference to a previous submission agreement(s) which the information may have belonged to.
SIP7;INFO;An optional reference code indicating where in the archival hierarchy the package shall be placed in the OAIS.
SIP7;ERROR;The altRecordID with TYPE='REFERENCECODE' may exist only once.

SIP8;INFO;In cases where the SIP originates from other institutions maintaining a reference code structure, this element can be used to record these reference codes and therefore support the provenance of the package when a whole archival description is not submitted with the submission.
SIP9;INFO;A wrapper element that enables to encode the name of the organisation or person that originally created the data being transferred.
SIP9;ERROR;The agent with ROLE='CREATOR' may exist only once.
SIP15;ERROR;A wrapper element that enables to encode the name of the organisation or person submitting the package to the archive.
SIP21;INFO;A wrapper element that enables to encode the name of the contact person for the submission.
SIP26;INFO;A wrapper element that enables to encode the name of the organisation or person that preserves the package.
SIP5;INFO;A reference to the Submission Agreement associated with the package.
SIP6;INFO;An optional reference to a previous submission agreement(s) which the information may have belonged to.
SIP7;INFO;An optional reference code indicating where in the archival hierarchy the package shall be placed in the OAIS.
